description: Search the sports coaches listed on SportPoint (Bulgaria). Filter by sport, city, age group or free text (coach name or sport). Returns ten coaches per page, each with a public profile url. Sport and city values are in Bulgarian; call list_sports_and_cities for the valid values.

search.description: Free text matched against coach names and sport names.

sport.description: Sport name in Bulgarian (e.g. "Плуване") or its slug (e.g. "pluvane").

name: search_coaches
title: Search Coaches
